title: Document upload and extraction
summary: Uploading a PDF and getting the fields back works. Two things need fixing first: a slow AI response crashes the request, and an empty PDF causes an error.

findings.title: AI call can hang or crash the request
findings.problem: The model is called without a timeout, and its errors aren't caught.
findings.impact: If the AI service is slow or busy during the demo, the upload spins forever and then shows an error.
findings.fix: Add a 30-second timeout, catch errors, and return a friendly message the UI can show.

findings.title: Empty PDF causes an error
findings.problem: The code reads the first page without checking that the PDF has any text.
findings.impact: Uploading a scanned or empty PDF crashes with a server error.
findings.fix: Return 'No readable text in this PDF' when nothing is extracted.

findings.title: Unused imports
findings.impact: The linter fails; no effect on the app.

next_steps: Fix F1 and F2, then ask for another review
Add a scanned PDF to the demo samples
